meta.title: Fathom Search
meta.description: Adds Fathom Search tools — multi-engine web and vertical search (GitHub, Hugging Face, arXiv, Semantic Scholar, PubMed, Wikidata, Wikipedia, Hacker News, Grok/X), image search, page extraction and quota checks — with multi-key rotation and failover. The built-in web_search is left untouched.
